subject: Problem with copy to clipboard button

messages.author: 3fd19fd766bba142
messages.subject: Problem with copy to clipboard button
parts:
Hi,

I have included a button in my shiny app that should allow users to copy the content of a data.frame to clipboard so they could later paste it to Excel for further processing. The button is associated with a observedEvent call to the clipr::write_clip function as suggested in https://gist.github.com/jimhester/18b9116a415633e5a73d

This works fine when I run the app locally from RStudio but not when I deploy the app on our open Shiny Server (FYI: xclip is installed on the server). Clicking on the button that triggers the copy does literally nothing: no error but no action either... the clipboard remains empty.

Is this a server configuration problem or a coding problem? Any suggestion to debug the issue?

Thank you in advance for your help.
